Movidacare

Movida is a California-based company that offers natural deodorants crafted with premium-grade oils and free from harmful phthalates. Their products are aluminum-free, phthalate-free, and ozokerite-free, focusing on sustainability by using post-consumer recycled plastic for packaging.

Successfully integrated all components for seamless functionality. Additionally, managed product listings and updates.

Stack

Shopify Liquid (schemas, metafields, metaobjects), Shopify CLI, BunJS, Typescript, Javascript, Web Components, SCSS, TailwindCSS
